title: GeneratedMCPServerPackage.authConfig
description: Runtime auth configuration shipped in a Generated MCP Server Package (FR-014, FR-014a, FR-016). Pluggable per constitution v1.2.0 Principle V. 'strategy' selects the branch; when absent it defaults to 'oauth' for backward compatibility. Contains NO secrets, raw tokens, or reused cookies — credentials live only in a RuntimeAuthSession, never here. Filename stays oauthConfig.json for compatibility.

strategy.description: Which runtime auth strategy this package uses (FR-014). Defaults to 'oauth' when omitted.

clientId.description: OAuth strategy only. Public client id; never a secret.

redirectMode.description: OAuth strategy only. loopback: stdio opens a 127.0.0.1 callback. hosted: streamable-http uses hostedRedirectUri (FR-016).

hostedRedirectUri.description: OAuth strategy, required when redirectMode is 'hosted'.

scopes.description: OAuth strategy. Minimum scopes for the included tools.

cdpUrl.description: session-reuse strategy. Default Chrome DevTools endpoint (e.g. http://localhost:9222); overridable at deploy time; never a secret.

cookieHosts.description: session-reuse strategy. Hosts whose cookies the runtime reads and attaches (typically the tools' baseUrl hosts).

loginUrl.description: session-reuse strategy. Optional URL to navigate the browser to when a session is missing/expired.

headerName.description: api-key strategy. Header the credential is sent in (e.g. Authorization, X-API-Key).

valuePrefix.description: api-key strategy. Optional prefix prepended to the credential value (e.g. 'Bearer ').

fallback.description: Documented fallback for webapps that do not support OAuth (spec edge case).
